spec.source_text: Next, the first quartz boat with S powder was placed in the low temperature zone of the tube furnace, and then the second quartz boat with MoO3 powder and SiO2/Si substrate was placed in the middle position of the tube furnace, wherein the cleaned SiO2/Si substrate was placed face down on the downstream from the MoO3 powder for 5 cm, as shown in Figure 1a. [...] During the heating process, argon gas with a flow rate of 35 sccm was continuously supplied as the carrier gas. It can be observed from Figure 1c that the temperature of the SiO2/Si substrate rises from room temperature to 550 °C in 20 min initially, then rises to 720 °C in 10 min, and maintains the growth temperature 720 °C in 10 min, and then cools to room temperature naturally.

calcs.label: Mo-edge attachment barrier
calcs.rationale: Pin down k_attach_Mo.Ea_eV (Mo-edge attachment barrier) with ReaxFF/MLIP attachment barrier (NEB) [medium]: its one-sigma uncertainty (0.05 eV) moves the triangle-hexagon shape boundary position from the MoO3 boat by 0.243 cm.

calcs.label: MoO3 vapour pressure at 1000 K (scales the fit above; legacy basis: absolute)
calcs.rationale: Pin down MoO3.P_ref_Pa (MoO3 vapour pressure at 1000 K (scales the fit above; legacy basis: absolute)) with DFT/JANAF thermochemistry of gas species [cheap]: its one-sigma uncertainty (37.3 Pa) moves the triangle-hexagon shape boundary position from the MoO3 boat by 0.221 cm.

calcs.label: Mo-edge attachment prefactor (S feed)
calcs.rationale: Pin down k_attach_Mo.A (Mo-edge attachment prefactor (S feed)) with MLIP-MD / TST attachment prefactor [expensive]: its one-sigma uncertainty (0.03 um/s/Pa) moves the triangle-hexagon shape boundary position from the MoO3 boat by 0.181 cm.

calcs.label: Sulfur evaporation coefficient
calcs.rationale: Pin down alpha_S (Sulfur evaporation coefficient) with MLIP-MD evaporation/sticking coefficient [expensive]: its one-sigma uncertainty (0.3 -) moves the triangle-hexagon shape boundary position from the MoO3 boat by 3.18e-06 cm.

calcs.label: Mo-zigzag edge energy per site
calcs.rationale: Pin down gamma_edge_Mo.gamma_eV (Mo-zigzag edge energy per site) with DFT edge energy vs mu_S (nanoribbon) [medium]: its one-sigma uncertainty (0.05 eV) moves the triangle-hexagon shape boundary position from the MoO3 boat by 0 cm.
